provenance: Per-file hashes describe the inspected working tree; the commit does not imply a clean checkout.

description.value:
Battle is the troop's core melee attack. Every troop has its own named Battle attack, marked [Battle], carrying its individual damage values.

Frequency once per round

Effect Spending 1 to 3 actions, the troop attacks each enemy in a 5-foot emanation. Each enemy takes the damage listed on the troop's [Battle] attack for the number of actions spent, with a basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC. An off-guard enemy takes a -2 circumstance penalty to this save.

Salvo is the troop's core ranged attack. A troop with ranged weapons has its own named Salvo attack, marked [Salvo], carrying its individual damage, area, and range.

Effect The troop looses a coordinated volley: a burst within the range listed on the troop's [Salvo] attack. Each creature in the area takes the listed damage with a basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC. An off-guard creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to this save. When the troop is reduced to 2 segments, the burst's area decreases as listed.

The troop breaks contact and pulls back. The troop moves up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

The troop can't move through squares occupied by enemies.
The troop chooses one of the squares it currently occupies and moves, condensing into a contiguous formation that includes that square. The troop can't share space with other creatures.

Whenever a troop Strides, it first Forms Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by-20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then moves up to its Speed. This works just like a Gargantuan creature moving; for instance, if any square of the troop enters difficult terrain, the extra movement cost applies to the whole troop.

Requirements The troop has the Combat Medics tactic.

Effect The troop's medics patch up wounds mid-battle, using the Treat Wounds DCs and healing amounts. Target the troop itself or an adjacent allied troop. Choose a DC based on the troop's level: DC 15 (any level), DC 20 (level 5+), DC 30 (level 10+), or DC 40 (level 15+). Attempt a Medicine check against that DC.

Critical Success The target regains 4d8 HP (DC 15), 4d8+10 HP (DC 20), 4d8+30 HP (DC 30), or 4d8+50 HP (DC 40).

Success The target regains 2d8 HP (DC 15), 2d8+10 HP (DC 20), 2d8+30 HP (DC 30), or 2d8+50 HP (DC 40).

Critical Failure The target takes 1d8 damage.

A troop treated this way can't be the target of this troop's Battlefield Medicine again for 1 hour.

The troop Strides up to double its Speed. Each enemy in a 5-foot emanation at the end of that movement takes the troop's two-action Battle damage, with a basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC. A creature that critically fails its save is also knocked prone.

The troop looses a suppressing stream of shots. Choose one enemy within the range of the troop's Salvo attack; that enemy attempts a Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC. The penalty is a status penalty and applies to the target's attack rolls and, if the target is a troop, to its Battle and Salvo DCs; any Speed penalty is also a status penalty. Both last until the start of the troop's next turn.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a -1 penalty.

Failure The target takes a -2 penalty and a -5-foot penalty to its Speeds.

Critical Failure The target takes a -3 penalty and a -10-foot penalty to its Speeds.

The troop uses shields, pikes, or positioning to protect an adjacent ally. Choose one adjacent allied creature or troop. Until the start of the troop's next turn, that ally cannot be flanked by enemies the troop threatens, and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saves against Battle and Salvo attacks from enemies the troop threatens.

Additionally, while the troop is benefiting from a fortification, it gains an additional +1 status bonus to AC and to saves against Battle and Salvo attacks (+2 at 9th level, +3 at 17th level).

Requirements The troop can see an enemy within 30 feet.

Effect With war cries, clashing weapons, and shows of force, the troop attempts an Intimidation check against the target's Will DC.

Critical Success The target becomes frightened 2.

Success The target becomes frightened 1.

The target is then temporarily immune to the troop's Demoralize for 10 minutes.
The troop fights dirty: hamstringing, gouging, and cutting from behind. A creature that fails its save against the troop's Battle attack is also frightened 1, or frightened 2 if it critically fails.

Trigger An enemy's action forces the troop to attempt a save or check to avoid becoming routed, and the troop succeeds.

Effect The troop feigns defeat to draw that enemy in. Attempt a Deception check against the enemy's Perception DC.

Critical Success The enemy is off-guard and can't take reactions until the start of the troop's next turn.

Success The enemy is off-guard until the start of the troop's next turn.

Critical Failure The enemy sees through the ruse, and the troop is off-guard until the start of its next turn.

The troop feints to create an opening. Attempt a Deception check against the target's Perception DC.

Critical Success The target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its saves against the troop's Battle and Salvo attacks until the start of the troop's next turn.

Success The target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its save against the troop's next Battle or Salvo attack this turn.

Requirements The troop has the Shield Discipline tactic.

Effect The troop raises its shields, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to saves against Battle and Salvo attacks until the start of its next turn. This bonus increases to +3 against physical ranged attacks, including Salvo attacks.

rules.label: Shields raised (until the start of next turn)

description.value:
Trigger A creature within the troop's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The troop lashes out at the triggering creature, dealing its two-action Battle damage (basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC). If the creature critically fails its saving throw and the trigger was a manipulate action, the troop disrupts that action.

Requirements The troop has the Shield Discipline tactic.

Trigger The troop has its shields raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The troop snaps its shields into place, preventing damage up to the Hardness of its shields.

The troop excels at surprise attacks. If the troop acts before all enemies in the first round of combat, it gains a +2 status bonus to its Battle DC for its first Battle or Salvo attack that round. The troop can attempt a Stealth check for initiative.

The troop shifts its tactics to suit the terrain. Choose one benefit, which lasts until the start of the troop's next turn: ignore ground-based difficult terrain, or gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saves against Battle and Salvo attacks.

rules.label: Battlefield Adaptability (AC and saves vs Battle/Salvo)

description.value: The troop fights harder when desperate. While the troop's HP is at or below its first threshold, it gains a +1 status bonus to AC, to saves against Battle and Salvo attacks, and to its Battle DC (+2 at 10th level or higher).

rules.label: Bloodied (at or below first HP threshold)

description.value: The troop marches with trained medics who can work in the thick of battle. The troop gains the Battlefield Medicine war action.

Aura 60 feet (emotion, mental, visual)

Allies starting their turn in range gain temporary Hit Points equal to the troop's level (minimum 5), lasting until the start of their next turn.
The troop forages and hunts to sustain itself indefinitely, costing the kingdom no food. It still draws its pay like any other army.
The troop ignores difficult terrain caused by plants and fungi, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.
The troop locks shields to protect its ranks. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to saves against Battle and Salvo attacks until the start of its next turn.

rules.label: Form a Phalanx (until the start of next turn)

description.value: When the troop uses Demoralize, it gains a +2 status bonus on the check.
The troop is trained to stand firm against terror. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus on saves against fear effects and reduce the value of any frightened condition they gain by 1 (minimum 0).
The troop carries extra ammunition and supplies. They do not run out of ammunition during tactical encounters and can sustain prolonged engagements without resupply.

Aura 60 feet (emotion, mental, visual)

Allies who can see the battle standard gain a +1 status bonus to initiative and saves against fear effects. Each time an affected creature gains the frightened condition, reduce the frightened value by 1.
The troop includes vigilant scouts and spotters. They gain a +2 status bonus to initiative checks and Perception checks to Seek hidden creatures.

The troop attacks in relentless waves. When the troop spends 3 actions on its Battle attack, each creature in the area takes a -1 circumstance penalty to its save against that attack. At 15th level, the penalty increases to -2. Salvo is always a single action, so it is never affected.

Trigger An enemy the troop is engaged with attempts to move away from it.

Effect The troop keeps pace with the retreating foe, moving up to its Speed and following the enemy so that it stays in reach throughout that enemy's movement, until the enemy stops moving or the troop has moved its full Speed. The troop can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if it has the corresponding movement type.

If any effect would force the troop to move, reduce the distance by 5 feet. Any time the troop would be affected by the fleeing condition, it is instead slowed 2 for the same duration. At 12th level, reduce forced movement by 10 feet instead.
If the troop rolls higher initiative than all enemies, it can Stride as a free action before its first turn begins.

The mounts trample anything they can knock down. Creatures that are Medium or smaller, and troops without mounts, take a -1 status penalty to their saves against the troop's Battle attack; this penalty increases to -2 at 15th level.

The mounts are hard to rein in: until 10th level, the troop takes a -1 status penalty to Reflex saves against area effects and to Will saves against mental effects.
Requires Siege Training (expert rank, 5th level or higher). When the troop Aims a siege engine, it can Launch as part of the same activity. The once-per-round Launch cap still applies.
Requires Siege Training. The troop's crews drill until loading is reflex: each Load repetition on a siege engine takes 1 action instead of 2.

Trigger An enemy critically fails its save against the troop's Battle attack.

Effect Infused with furious vigor at its devastating blow, the troop regains Hit Points equal to its level.
The troop ignores the penalty for attacking while on a vehicle that has moved in the last round, and takes only a -2 penalty if the vehicle is uncontrolled or used an action with the reckless trait.
The troop drills with shields until raising them is second nature. The troop gains the Raise Shields war action, and the Shield Block reaction while it carries shields.

The troop overlaps its shields into a barricade, gaining standard cover until the start of its next turn. The troop can Take Cover behind the wall for greater cover, but the wall is too obvious to Hide behind.

The troop learns to crew siege engines. It gains the trained rank in the Siege Weapons proficiency, automatically improving to expert at 5th level and master at 13th level (no legendary rank without a specialist doctrine). Once trained or better, its Launch DC when operating a siege engine is the higher of the engine's listed DC or 10 + its level + its Siege Weapons proficiency bonus.
Each ally within 60 feet who can see the banner can use a reaction to Stand, Step, or Stride.
Grants 10 temporary Hit Points to all allies within 60 feet who can see the banner. These temporary HP last for 1 minute.
While moving on land, the troop ignores difficult terrain caused by debris, rough ground, or sand.
At the start of its turn, the troop attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success, it removes one condition affecting it (such as frightened, slowed, or enfeebled).

Frequency once per round

The unit Strides, then attempts either an Athletics check to Trip all adjacent enemies, or an Intimidation check to Demoralize all enemies within 30 feet. Roll once and compare the result to each enemy's relevant DC.
The troop is particularly hardy. They gain +10 maximum Hit Points, plus +2 for each level above 1st.

The troop Strides up to double its Speed and can move through spaces occupied by creatures of its size or smaller. Each creature it moves through takes the troop's two-action Battle damage with a basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC. A creature can take this damage only once per Trample.
The troop moves about in a haphazard mob, so ranged Strikes against it take a -2 circumstance penalty and the troop gains a +2 circumstance bonus on its saves against Salvo attacks.
The troop serves from loyalty and duty, drawing no pay from the kingdom's treasury. It must still be fed like any other army.
The troop requires no base of operations. It never needs a garrison and does not count against a settlement's garrison capacity. Wherever they lay their head is home.

Trigger The troop would become frightened or increase its frightened condition while it is not routed.

Effect The troop channels its panic into energy. It ignores that increase to its frightened condition and gains a +1 bonus to its next skill check or saving throw, or to its Battle DC for its next Battle or Salvo attack.

The troop ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp or water. While fighting in swamp or water terrain, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Athletics and Stealth checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to its Battle DC.
The troop holds its nerve. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus on saves against fear effects and on any save or check made to avoid becoming routed.

When the troop damages a creature with its Battle, that creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:24] save or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure) from the brutality of the attack.

The troop's incendiary weapons ignite targets even in a melee scrum. A creature that critically fails its save against the troop's Battle attack takes moderate persistent fire damage for the troop's level.

The constant terrifying croaking imposes a -2 status penalty on every adjacent enemy's saves against fear effects and on any save or check it makes to avoid becoming routed. The troop can use the Demoralize action.

When the troop is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its alchemical engine detonates. Each creature adjacent to the troop must attempt a basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC, taking the troop's two-segment Battle damage on a failure (doubled on a critical failure). If the troop is later restored above 0 Hit Points, its alchemical engine rebuilds automatically.

Frequency once per encounter.

Effect The troop charges, Striding up to twice its Speed. Each enemy in a 5-foot emanation at the end of that movement takes the troop's two-segment Battle damage, with a basic Reflex save against the troop's Battle DC.

The troop can hurl weighted nets in place of its usual Salvo attack. The nets deal no damage; instead, each creature that fails its save is slowed 1 (slowed 2 on a critical failure) as it is entangled. A creature slowed this way can spend an action to attempt an Escape against the troop's Battle DC to end the effect. The troop cannot hurl nets beyond the range of its Salvo attack.

Requirement The troop is not routed.

Effect The troop unleashes primal magic at an enemy, which must attempt a Will save against the troop's spell DC. On a failure, roll 1d10 for the effect (failure as listed; critical failure increases the value or damage by 1): 1-2 Entangling Vines the target is slowed 1; 3-4 Horrific Visions the target is frightened 1; 5-6 Primal Storm the target takes the troop's two-segment Battle damage as electricity damage and is off-guard until the end of its next turn; 7-8 Choking Pollen the target is sickened 1; 9-10 Befuddling Glamer the target is stupefied 1.
The troop is less organized than most. It can move into other creatures' spaces, and other creatures can move into its spaces. The troop's spaces are difficult terrain to other creatures.

If the battle takes place in swamp or water terrain, the troop can begin the encounter already adjacent to an enemy. If it does, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its Battle DC against that enemy during the first round.
When a creature critically fails its save against the troop's Battle or Salvo attack, eerie side effects wrack it: it becomes enfeebled 1 until the start of its next turn.
The troop ignores difficult terrain caused by water or swamps and gains a +4 circumstance bonus on initiative checks when the battle features either terrain.

A creature that fails its save against the troop's Battle attack is exposed to wyvern venom: it takes moderate persistent poison damage for the troop's level and is enfeebled 1 for as long as the persistent damage continues.

The archers draw or reload longbows and launch a coordinated volley. Creates a 10-foot burst within 100 feet dealing @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save). The burst reduces to 5 feet when the troop has 2 or fewer segments.
The infantry launches a crossbow salvo in a 10-foot burst within 120 feet, dealing @Damage[2d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). At 2 or fewer segments, burst reduces to 5 feet.
The guards ignore difficult terrain caused by crowds or from movement through narrow spaces such as alleyways.

Frequency once per round

Melee attack against all enemies in a 5-foot emanation (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save).

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(1d6+2)[slashing]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(2d6+7)[slashing]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(3d6+10)[slashing]]

The archer regiment draws daggers to attack close-range enemies. Each enemy in a 5-foot emanation must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save. The archer regiment gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of their next turn.

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(2d4+2)[piercing]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(4d4+12)[piercing]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(4d4+15)[piercing]]

Frequency once per round

The unit uses the Change Formation ability. The unit typically knows multiple formations such as loose, marching column, or wedge.
The infantry Strides up to double its Speed. Enemies within a 5-foot emanation at the end of the movement take @Damage[(2d6+5)[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save).
The troop can move through other creatures' spaces, and other creatures can move through its spaces. The troop's squares count as difficult terrain to other creatures.

The pack focuses all their efforts on biting a single adjacent foe, who takes @Damage[(4d6+8)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). If the creature fails this saving throw, the pack can immediately attempt an Athletics check to [[/act trip]] the creature.

Members throw spears in a volley. Each creature in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet must make a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save, taking @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]] damage. When reduced to 2 or fewer segments, the burst area shrinks to 5 feet.

Frequency once per round

The squad lashes out at all creatures within 5 feet using modified farm implements, making no distinction between allies and enemies. A @Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save applies to all targets in the area.

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[1d8[piercing]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(1d8+4)[piercing]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(2d8+4)[piercing]]

Frequency once per round

The cavalry swings flails at each enemy within a 5-foot emanation (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save). Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(2d6+7)[bludgeoning]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(3d6+10)[bludgeoning]]

Requirements The troop's last action was a Battle attack that dealt damage.

One ally within 30 feet gains a +3 status bonus to its next Strike before the troop's next turn; an ally that is itself a troop instead gains a +3 status bonus to its Battle DC for its next Battle or Salvo attack.

The brigade Strides twice with a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed. After moving at least 10 feet, each enemy in a 10-foot emanation at the end of movement takes @Damage[(3d8+14)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save).

Frequency once per round

Coordinated melee attack against all enemies in a 10-foot emanation (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save).

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[1d10[piercing]] or slashing
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(1d10+7)[piercing]] or slashing
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(1d10+10)[piercing]] or slashing

Coordinated longspear attack against nearby enemies (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save).

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[2d8[piercing]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(3d8+8)[piercing]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(4d8+8)[piercing]]
Effects that target only animals or only humanoids might not work on the cavalry brigade, subject to the GM's discretion.
When the troop would be forced to move, reduce the distance by 10 feet (instead of 5). The fleeing condition becomes slowed 2 instead for this troop.

1 to 3

The pack works together to fell their opponents. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] attempts a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save. A creature who is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} for this attack. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d6+1)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d6+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(2d6+11)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

Requirements The infantry is in phalanx formation.

The infantry Strides in a straight line toward an enemy, then uses Lower Spears! [Battle] dealing @Damage[(3d8+8)[piercing]] damage. Creatures that fail their save are also knocked prone.

The archer regiment fires their longbows in a coordinated volley. Choose either:

  • A 15-foot burst within 200 feet that deals @Damage[4d8[piercing]] damage, or
  • A 10-foot burst within 100 feet that deals @Damage[6d8[piercing]] damage

Targets make a @Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save. When reduced to 2 segments, both areas are reduced by 5 feet.
By spending 1 minute to designate a single creature they can physically describe, the guards gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against that quarry.

Frequency once per round

The shambler troop attacks all creatures in its squares or within 5 feet (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save).

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(2d6+5)[bludgeoning]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(2d6+9)[bludgeoning]]
Launch a crossbow volley in a 10-foot burst within 120 feet, dealing @Damage[2d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save). Reduces to 5-foot burst at 2 segments or fewer.
The troop is permanently slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

Frequency once per round

The phalanx thrusts longspears in all directions at enemies within a 10-foot emanation. All foes attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save.

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(1d8+2)[piercing]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(2d8+5)[piercing]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(3d8+5)[piercing]]

Frequency once per round

Coordinated lance attack against each enemy in a 10-foot emanation (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save). Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(1d6+3)[piercing]]
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(2d6+10)[piercing]]
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(3d6+14)[piercing]]
The brigade ignores difficult terrain while moving on land.

When the troop Casts a Spell, its constituent members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version of the spell than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.
At the start of each turn, the squad must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:10] check or become confused for that turn.

Frequency once per round

The cultists swing various weapons at adjacent enemies while taking self-inflicted damage. All enemy targets make a @Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save.

Damage scales with actions spent:

  • 1 action: @Damage[(1d12+1)[slashing]] to enemies; @Damage[1d4[slashing]] to troop
  • 2 actions: @Damage[(2d12+1)[slashing]] to enemies; @Damage[(1d4+2)[slashing]] to troop
  • 3 actions: @Damage[(2d12+5)[slashing]] to enemies; @Damage[2d4[slashing]] to troop

The army inspires allies through unwavering conviction and righteous purpose.

Effect: This army and all allied armies within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls and saving throws against fear effects.

grant.name: Inspiring Aura
grant.description: +1 status to initiative and saves vs fear
grant.fullDescription: The army inspires nearby allies. This army and all allied armies within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls and saving throws against fear effects.

description.value:
The army radiates an aura of holy righteousness that shields allies against unholy forces.

Effect: This army and all allied armies within 20 feet gain a +2 status bonus to AC against unholy creatures and deal an additional 2 damage against unholy creatures.

grant.name: Aura of Righteousness
grant.description: +2 status AC vs unholy, +2 status damage vs unholy
grant.fullDescription: The army radiates an aura of holy righteousness. This army and all allied armies within 20 feet gain a +2 status bonus to AC against unholy creatures and deal an additional 2 damage against unholy creatures.

description.value:
The army fights with ruthless aggression, showing no mercy to their foes.

Effect: This army and all allied armies within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

grant.name: No Quarter!
grant.description: +1 status to attack and damage rolls
grant.fullDescription: The army fights with ruthless aggression. This army and all allied armies within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

description.value:
The army radiates an aura of dread and hopelessness that breaks the will of enemies.

Effect: Enemy armies within 60 feet become demoralized 1 and cannot reduce their demoralized value below 1 while they remain in the aura.

Immunity: Creatures immune to fear are unaffected.

grant.name: Despair
grant.description: Demoralized 1 aura (can't naturally recover while in area)
grant.fullDescription: The army radiates an aura of despair. Enemy armies within 60 feet become demoralized 1 and cannot reduce their demoralized value below 1 while they remain in the aura.

description.value:
The army rallies its allies with disciplined coordination and tactical support.

Effect: This army and all allied armies within 60 feet gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws.

grant.name: Rally
grant.description: +1 circumstance to AC and saving throws
grant.fullDescription: The army rallies its allies with disciplined coordination. This army and all allied armies within 60 feet gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws.

description.value:
Trigger The army is struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

Through relentless drilling and tactical conditioning, this army can shrug off even grievous injuries. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.

grant.name: Rigorous Discipline
grant.description: Reaction: DC 17 flat check to downgrade critical hit to normal hit
grant.fullDescription: The army's rigorous training allows them to resist devastating blows. When an enemy scores a critical hit against the army, the army can use a reaction to attempt a DC 17 flat check. On a success, the critical hit becomes a normal hit instead.
